title: Avatar
summary: Two additive changes. A failing image URL now falls back to the custom content or initials, exactly like an avatar with no src (before, the browser's broken-image glyph and alt text showed inside the circle); nothing changes while the image loads. A new AvatarGroup export stacks avatars with an 8px overlap (4px at xs and sm, where 8px would hide the initials) and a 2px surface-coloured ring, and max collapses the rest into a same-size "+N" tile.
apiNote: Avatar props and exports are unchanged. New: `AvatarGroup` export (props: max, size, plus div attributes; role="group"). No hash-coloured fallbacks and no fade-in: avatars stay static per design/V2-MOTION.md.
why: A dead image URL (deleted photo, expired signed URL, offline) leaves a broken-image icon in the circle in every browser; HeroUI and Mantine avatars both fall back to initials or a placeholder on image error.

Overlapping stacks with a ring in the surface colour and a "+N" overflow tile are the standard group pattern in Untitled UI, HeroUI AvatarGroup and Mantine Avatar.Group; the ring keeps adjacent avatars readable on any fill.
One-accent rule: no per-user hashed background colours; the tile and fallbacks stay neutral.
Research references (HeroUI, Mantine, shadcn/ui, Untitled UI, React Aria) come from the task brief's research conclusions; they were not re-verified source by source while implementing.

scenarioLabels.states-image-initials-icon: Generated initials, explicit initials, image, custom children (the failing-image card is new)
scenarioLabels.broken-image: Image that fails to load, name given: before = broken-image glyph and alt text, after = initials
scenarioLabels.broken-image-icon-fallback: Image fails to load with icon children: before = broken image, after = the icon
scenarioLabels.group: NEW AvatarGroup, md, max 3 (before = the closest existing story, individual avatars without overlap)
scenarioLabels.group-sizes: NEW AvatarGroup at all five sizes (before = the sizes story, single avatars)

motion.after: None by design: avatars are deliberately static (no fade-in, no hover motion)

states: Avatar / Image: add a documentation note that a failed image shows the same visual as the matching Initials (or Icon) variant; no new Figma variant is needed
AvatarGroup (NEW component): Size = xs | sm | md | lg | xl, Overflow = off | on ("+N" tile)
AvatarGroup / Overflow tile (NEW): same size as its neighbours, neutral fill, "+N" label
figmaSteps: Image avatars: no visual change when the photo loads. For prototypes of the failure case, duplicate the Initials (or Icon) variant and label it "Image failed to load"; it must look identical to the Initials variant (soft: fill #ECF1FB, text #707070, Inter 500).
Create component AvatarGroup: auto layout horizontal, item spacing -8 (negative), align items center, hug contents, canvas stacking = Last on top (later avatars sit over earlier ones).

Group item: any Avatar instance (24 / 30 / 40 / 48 / 64 px by size) with an OUTSIDE stroke 2px #FFFFFF (semantic-bg-primary); the ring is drawn outside the circle, so the circle diameter does not change. On a tinted surface use that surface colour for the ring.

Overflow tile (new variant of Avatar, same size as its neighbours): corner radius 9999, fill #F5F5F5 (semantic-bg-ui), same 2px #FFFFFF outside stroke, centred label "+N" (N = hidden count) in Inter 500, colour #5E5E5E (--v2-text-secondary), font size by size: xs 10, sm 12, md 14, lg 16, xl 18. The tile counts as an extra item after the max avatars (max 3 of 6 shows 3 avatars + "+3").

Measured overlap is exactly 8px at every size (xs 24, sm 30, md 40, lg 48, xl 64). Group widths for 4 items (3 avatars + tile): xs 72, sm 96, md 136, lg 168, xl 232 (n x size - (n-1) x 8, excluding the ring).
Provide the Size property on the group; the group size applies to avatars that do not set their own. Accessible text (docs): group label via aria-label, tile label "N more".
notes: DECIDED: overlap is 8px from md up and 4px at xs (24px) and sm (30px), because 8px clips the covered initials at those sizes. Group widths for 4 items (3 avatars + tile), excluding the ring: xs 84, sm 108, md 136, lg 168, xl 232.
The ring colour is the surface colour --semantic-bg-primary (white). On a grey card pass className="[&>*]:ring-semantic-bg-ui".
Pre-existing, not changed here: the soft variant's initials (#707070 on #ECF1FB) fail axe colour contrast in the story sweep.
max counts avatars shown before the tile (the tile is extra). max=0 shows only "+N"; non-finite max shows all.
A failed image is detected via the img onError event. An image that already failed before React attached the handler (server-rendered markup) is not re-checked; this app is client rendered.
Research references (HeroUI, Mantine, shadcn/ui, Untitled UI, React Aria) come from the task brief's research conclusions; they were not re-verified source by source while implementing.
